name: Building and Safety Certificate of Occupancy
description: The Department of Building and Safety is required by the Los Angeles Municipal Code to issue a Certificate of Occupancy for every building or structure in the City of Los Angeles.  A Certificate of Occupancy is a document issued by the Department of Building and Safety certifying a building's compliance with applicable building codes and other laws, and indicating it to be in a condition suitable for occupancy.

columns.name: Reference # (Old Permit #)
columns.description: A sequential reference number issued by the Cashiering System, and used to file and retrieve original paper copies.

columns.name: PCIS Permit #
columns.description: This is the permit number assigned by the Plan Check and Inspection System as soon as an application for a permit has been filed. Before a permit is issued, the number is known as the Application Number. After the permit is issued, this same number becomes the Permit Number.

columns.name: Permit Type
columns.description: Permit application type.

columns.name: Permit Sub-Type
columns.description: The permit sub-type determines whether the permit application is for a 1 or 2 family dwelling, a multi-family dwelling, or a commercial structure.

columns.name: Permit Category
columns.description: Permit category is used to determine how the permit application will be handled within the LADBS public counter and regular plan check business process.

columns.name: Project Number
columns.description: A number used to associate a permit application with a specific construction or a development project consisting of several permit applications.

columns.name: Event Code
columns.description: An event code, usually synonymous with a disaster code, represents permits issued related to repairing, demolishing, or rebuilding structures damaged from a disaster.

columns.name: Initiating Office
columns.description: Office location where the permit application is initiated, not necessarily issued.

columns.name: Permit Issue Date
columns.description: The date when the permit was issued.

columns.name: Address Start
columns.description: Beginning house number of property address on permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 N Main Ave", Address Start is 200. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Address Start is 202.

columns.name: Address Fraction Start
columns.description: Beginning fraction of property address on permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 N Main Ave", Address Fraction Start is null. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Address Fraction Start is 1/4.

columns.name: Address End
columns.description: Ending house number of property address on permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 N Main Ave", Address End is 200. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Address End is 204.

columns.name: Address Fraction End
columns.description: Ending house number fraction of property address on permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 N Main Ave", Address Fraction End is null. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Address Fraction End is 1/2.

columns.name: Street Direction
columns.description: Street direction of property address for permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 Main Ave", Street Direction is null. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Street Direction is N.

columns.name: Street Name
columns.description: Street name of property address for permit application.

columns.name: Street Suffix
columns.description: Street suffix of property address for permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 Main Ave", Street Suffix is Ave. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Street Suffix is St.

columns.name: Suffix Direction
columns.description: Street suffix direction of property address for permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 N Main Ave", Suffix Direction is null. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Suffix Direction is SE.

columns.name: Unit Range Start
columns.description: Beginning unit number of property address on permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 N Main Ave, #1-#8", Unit Range Start is #1. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Unit Range Start is null.

columns.name: Unit Range End
columns.description: Ending unit number of property address on permit application. Example 1: For "200 - 200 N Main Ave, #1-#8", Unit Range End is #8. Example 2: For "202 1/4 - 204 1/2 N Main St SE", Unit Range End is null.

columns.name: Zip Code
columns.description: Zip code of property address for permit application.

columns.name: Work Description
columns.description: Describes the work to be performed under the permit application.

columns.name: Valuation
columns.description: The property/structure valuation amount is used to calculate the building permit fee and all fees calculated as percentage of the building fee. For all building permit types, except for Grading, the valuation is measured in dollars. For Grading permit applications, the valuation is measured in cubic yards of soil removed or added.
